description: Read the full text content from a PDF or plain-text file at the given path. PDF files are extracted page-by-page; all other files are read as plain text.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the PDF or plain-text file to read.

name: read_pdf_file

outputSchema.description: Extracted text content of the file.

content.description: Full text extracted from the file. For PDFs, pages are separated by newlines.
